name: Watcher
description: An icon beside the notch while the microphone or the camera is in use, and a popup when it starts.
author: Giuseppe
details: Know when the microphone or the camera is in use. A small icon appears beside the closed notch, orange for the microphone and green for the camera, and a popup says when it starts, with the apps that are recording when macOS names them. It never records or reads anything.
features: Icon beside the notch while in use
Names the apps using the microphone
